text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(To be the Queen of the Turf,
physical strength alone isn't enough.)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: (Strategy, technique—I must make full use of everything at my disposal to prepare an airtight plan...!)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—...Huh?
Is it really that late already...!?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer...!
Something like this, never again...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While devising countermeasures is commendable,
balancing them with training is crucial.
I made sure to firmly warn her so it wouldn't happen again.
